plain_load.sql: select date_trunc('day', ts) as day, sum(load_mw) as mw from grid_load where ts >= $from group by 1 order by 1

avg_income.sql: select region_code, avg(monthly_income_mdc) as avg_income, count(*) as n from household_survey group by region_code order by 1

avg_income_having.sql: select region_code, median(monthly_income_mdc) as m from household_survey group by region_code having count(*) > 100

small_groups.sql: select municipality, avg(monthly_income_mdc) as avg_income, count(*) as n from household_survey group by municipality

global_avg.sql: select avg(respondent_age) as age from household_survey

histogram.sql: select floor(monthly_income_mdc / 1000) * 1000 as band, count(*) as households from household_survey group by 1 order by 1

share_filter.sql: select region_code, count(*) filter (where monthly_income_mdc < 2000) * 1.0 / count(*) as share from household_survey group by all

where_filter.sql: select region_code, count(*) as n from household_survey where respondent_age > 60 group by region_code

row_level.sql: select household_id, monthly_income_mdc from household_survey limit 10

star_exclude.sql: select * exclude (household_id, monthly_income_mdc, respondent_age) from household_survey limit 3

whole_row.sql: select h from household_survey h limit 3

max_income.sql: select region_code, max(monthly_income_mdc) from household_survey group by 1

list_income.sql: select region_code, list(monthly_income_mdc) from household_survey group by 1

window.sql: select region_code, avg(monthly_income_mdc) over (partition by region_code) from household_survey

cte_leak.sql: with a as (select monthly_income_mdc as x, region_code from household_survey) select region_code, avg(x) from a group by 1

cte_ok.sql: with a as (select region_code, avg(monthly_income_mdc) as x from household_survey group by 1) select * from a order by x desc

subquery_scalar.sql: select region_code, (select max(monthly_income_mdc) from household_survey) as top from grid_load group by 1

order_leak.sql: select household_size from household_survey order by monthly_income_mdc desc limit 1

join_ok.sql: select h.region_code, avg(h.monthly_income_mdc) as income, max(g.load_mw) as peak from household_survey h join (select region_code, max(load_mw) as load_mw from grid_load group by 1) g using (region_code) group by 1

union_leak.sql: select region_code, count(*) from household_survey group by 1 union all select cast(monthly_income_mdc as varchar), 1 from household_survey
